en: Update checks reuse a verified downloaded installer and retain the ready-to-install action, including after restarting Prism.
Installer downloads display byte progress and stop with a retryable error if the connection stalls. Update indicators clear when the installed version is current.
zh: 检查更新会复用已下载并通过校验的安装包，保留安装入口；重启棱镜后再次检查也无需重复下载。
下载更新显示百分比和已下载大小；连接长时间无响应时明确报错并允许重试，真正更新完成后清除更新提示。
